scores.evidence: MVP: catalog, flat/per-seat subscriptions, invoicing, Stripe payments, a basic ledger, webhooks, pooled tenancy, one region.
scores.rationale: Phases broadly go simple to complex, but the ledger is only "basic" in MVP and full in phase 3, and nothing says what must be proven before each phase.

scores.evidence: MVP: catalog, flat/per-seat subscriptions, invoicing, Stripe payments, a basic ledger, webhooks, pooled tenancy, one region.
scores.rationale: The MVP is a thin-ish end-to-end slice, but it is a broad feature set and is not described as a production walking skeleton.
Irreversible choices such as sharding, ledger model and tenancy are stated as decisions, with no defaults, flip conditions or revisit triggers.
No ordering of work within phases by blast radius is given.

scores.evidence: Security and Compliance: OAuth2 / API keys scoped to a tenant... per-tenant KMS data keys... immutable log (WORM storage)
scores.rationale: Security is thorough but sits in a standalone section and is not tied to phases.

scores.evidence: SLO alerts: ingestion lag > 5 min, invoice finalization backlog, ledger imbalance (page immediately), and reconciliation drift.
scores.rationale: Observability is a standalone section and does not appear in the phased delivery, including Phase 0 or the MVP.
Nothing on reproducible builds, environments or infrastructure as code. Only replay of data and deterministic rating are mentioned.

scores.evidence: Failure recovery | Temporal workflows resume where they stopped, outbox plus idempotent consumers, and rating can be replayed from raw events
scores.rationale: Resilience is handled well in the architecture and in a table, but it is not threaded through the phases.
The plan never says whether an AI layer applies, so it does not declare N/A.

scores.evidence: Enterprise: siloed tenancy, EU/APAC cells, multiple PSPs, e-invoicing, contract and quote billing, custom dunning.
scores.rationale: Later phases imply deferred work, but there are no explicit not-built-yet lists or pull-forward conditions.

note: The architecture is technically strong, but it has little phase-level discipline: there are no tradeoff gates, no blast-radius ordering, no reproducibility, and no AI N/A statement, and cross-cutting concerns are standalone sections.
